map.化肥利用率（氮磷钾吸收率）估算 使用指南: Fertilizer use efficiency (NPK uptake) estimation user guide
map.输入施肥量与作物收获带走的养分量，按差减法分别计算氮、磷、钾的表观利用率，量化肥: Input fertilizer amount and nutrient removed by crop harvest; compute apparent use efficiency of N, P, K separately by the difference method, quantifying fertilizer uptake efficiency and loss share, providing a basis for fertilizer reduction and formula fertilization.
map.肥料吸收量 = 作物吸收量 − 土壤基础供肥量；表观利用率 = 肥料吸收量 ÷: Fertilizer uptake = crop uptake - soil basic fertilizer supply; apparent use efficiency = fertilizer uptake / fertilizer amount x 100%; unabsorbed amount = fertilizer amount - fertilizer uptake
map.差减法测算当季表观利用率：先扣除土壤基础供肥，得到由肥料贡献的吸收量，再除以施肥: Difference method for in-season apparent use efficiency: first subtract soil basic fertilizer supply to get uptake contributed by fertilizer, then divide by fertilizer amount for the efficiency. Unabsorbed part is the sum of residue and loss. Efficiency >=40% is high, 25%-40% normal, 15%-25% low, < 15% too low, with optimization advice for each.
map.肥料利用率 = (施肥区养分吸收量 − 不施肥区养分吸收量) / 施肥量 × 1: Fertilizer use efficiency = (nutrient uptake in fertilized plot - unfertilized plot) / fertilizer amount x 100%.
map.氮肥当季利用率常 30%~45%，磷钾更低。: In-season nitrogen use efficiency is often 30%-45%; phosphorus and potassium are lower.
map.用于评判施肥合理性与减肥潜力。: For judging fertilization rationality and fertilizer-reduction potential.
map.：施氮区吸氮 12 kg/亩，空白区吸氮 6 kg/亩，施纯 N 15 kg/亩: : N-applied plot absorbs 12 kg/mu N, blank plot 6 kg/mu, applied pure N 15 kg/mu. Nitrogen use efficiency = (12-6)/15 = 40%. At the normal level, with room to raise to 45%+ via deep placement and split application.
map.为什么氮肥利用率这么低？: Why is nitrogen fertilizer use efficiency so low?
map.氨挥发、硝化反硝化淋失、地表径流等损失大。深施覆土、分次追施、配缓释肥可显著减少: Losses from ammonia volatilization, nitrification-denitrification leaching and surface runoff are large. Deep placement with soil cover, split topdressing and slow-release fertilizer can significantly reduce loss; this is the core lever of the "zero growth of fertilizer" policy.
map.磷钾肥利用率为什么更难算？: Why is phosphorus/potassium use efficiency harder to compute?
map.磷在土壤固定、钾有矿物钾缓慢释放，当季吸收与施肥的对应关系弱，常用示踪法（¹⁵N: Phosphorus is fixed in soil and potassium has slowly released mineral potassium, so in-season uptake vs fertilization correspondence is weak; only tracer methods (N-15/P-32) are accurate, and the conventional difference method greatly overestimates error.
